task_prompt: Take a tube from the rack, mount a tip on the pipette, pipette into the tube, then put the tube back and set the pipette down.
task_summary: The left hand lifts a clear tube out of the orange rack and holds it; the right hand takes the micropipette from the rack, presses its nose onto a tip in the open tip box, dips the tip into the second tube still standing in the rack and draws with the plunger, then brings the tip into the held tube and works the plunger to dispense; the left hand returns its tube to the rack and the right hand lays the pipette on the table to the right of the rack.

environment.camera: fixed camera above the operator looking down the table

objects.name: orange tube rack

appearance.body: bright orange plastic block with a grid of round wells and perforated sides

objects.approximate_size: about two hand-spans long, a hand tall
properties: A rigid rack with vertical round wells; a tube or the pipette stands upright in a well and is lifted straight up to remove it.
It stays in place on the right half of the table; nothing moves it.
objects.initial_state: on the right half of the table holding two clear tubes and the pipette standing in its end well
objects.final_state: same place, holding both tubes; the pipette no longer in it
objects.evidence: the orange rack is visible in every frame; a tube leaves it at 6.6 s and returns at 26 to 27 s; the pipette leaves it at 10 to 11 s.

objects.name: clear plastic tube
properties: A rigid open-topped vessel held upright in one hand; the pipette tip is dipped into its opening.
It is lifted straight up out of a rack well and later lowered straight back into one.
objects.initial_state: standing in a well of the rack
objects.final_state: standing back in a well of the rack
objects.evidence: prompt: 'tube'; 5.3 to 7 s the left hand lifts it out of the rack; held upright until 26 s; 26 to 27.5 s put back in the rack.

objects.name: clear plastic tube in the rack

appearance.body: clear, open-topped, short cylinder, same as the held tube

properties: A second open-topped tube that stays standing in a rack well; the pipette tip is dipped into it to draw before dispensing into the held tube.
It is not grasped; it is held in place by the rack well.
objects.initial_state: standing in a well of the rack
objects.evidence: visible in the rack throughout; 17 to 19 s the pipette tip is lowered into it and the plunger worked.

objects.name: micropipette

appearance.body: white and grey with a blue-topped plunger button

properties: A hand-held pipette gripped around its body with the thumb on the plunger button; the plunger slides down under thumb pressure and springs back when released.
Its nose is pressed into a tip in the tip box to mount the tip by friction; the tip then stays on through the task.
Pipetting is repeated plunger strokes with the tip inside the tube.
It stands upright in a rack well at the start and lies on the table at the end.

articulation.range_observed: repeated short strokes of the plunger under the thumb
articulation.state_over_video: at rest in the rack -> plunger pressed several times (17 to 25 s) -> at rest on the table

objects.initial_state: standing in the rack's end well
objects.final_state: lying on the table to the right of the rack with the tip still mounted
objects.evidence: prompt: 'pipette'; 10 to 11 s the right hand lifts it from the rack; 12 to 15.5 s its nose is pressed into the tip box; 17 to 25 s the thumb works the plunger with the tip in the tube; 30 to 32 s it is laid down.

objects.name: blue pipette tip box

appearance.lid: translucent, hinged open at the back
appearance.tips: a grid of light blue tips standing upright

properties: An open box whose tray holds many tips standing upright in a grid; pressing the pipette nose straight down onto one tip mounts it and lifts it out.
The lid is already open and stays open; the box does not move.

articulation.axis: along the back edge of the box

objects.initial_state: open, on the left half of the table
objects.evidence: the box is visible open in every frame; 12 to 15.5 s the pipette is pressed into it and comes away with a tip.

objects.name: pipette tip
properties: A small tapered cone that mounts onto the pipette nose by friction and then moves with the pipette.
objects.final_state: mounted on the pipette lying on the table
objects.evidence: 15.5 s onward a tip is visible on the pipette nose.

subgoals.action: Lift a tube out of the rack.

hand_roles.left: Grasps the tube and lifts it straight up out of its well.

subgoals.goal: The tube is held upright in the left hand, clear of the rack.

subgoals.action: Take the pipette out of the rack.

hand_roles.right: Grips the pipette body and lifts it out of its well.

subgoals.goal: The pipette is held in the right hand.

subgoals.action: Press the pipette nose onto a tip in the tip box.

hand_roles.left: Holds the tube away from the box.
hand_roles.right: Lowers the pipette nose onto a tip and presses, then lifts.

subgoals.goal: A tip is mounted on the pipette and lifted out of the box.

subgoals.action: Dip the tip into the tube standing in the rack and draw with the plunger.

hand_roles.left: Holds its tube away from the rack.
hand_roles.right: Lowers the tip into the rack tube and presses and releases the plunger.

subgoals.goal: Intended outcome: liquid is drawn into the tip from the rack tube.
subgoals.observed_outcome: The tip is in the rack tube and the thumb works the plunger; liquid is not visible at this resolution.

subgoals.action: Bring the tip into the held tube and work the plunger to dispense.

hand_roles.left: Holds the tube upright and still.
hand_roles.right: Dips the tip into the tube and presses and releases the plunger with the thumb, repeatedly.

subgoals.goal: Intended outcome: the drawn liquid is dispensed into the held tube.
subgoals.observed_outcome: Several plunger strokes with the tip inside the held tube; liquid is not visible at this resolution.

subgoals.action: Put the tube back into the rack.

hand_roles.left: Lowers the tube into a well and lets go.

subgoals.goal: The tube stands in a rack well without support.

subgoals.action: Lay the pipette down on the table to the right of the rack.

hand_roles.right: Lowers the pipette onto the cloth and lets go.

subgoals.goal: The pipette lies on the table on its own.

task_success: The held tube stands back in the rack, the pipette with its tip lies on the table right of the rack, the rack tube has not moved, and the tip box is one tip short.
notes: Whether liquid is transferred cannot be seen; the plunger strokes are what the video shows.
Tip ejection is not observed: the tip is still on the pipette at the end.
